description: This Dart source file defines a controller class 'ContentDetailsController' used in a Flutter application to manage content details state, handle cache updates, user interactions like toggling watchlist status, and playback progress management.

classes.name: ContentDetailsState
classes.description: An enum representing the current state of the content details: loading, ready, notFound, or error.

classes.name: ContentDetailsController
classes.description: A controller class extending ChangeNotifier to manage content details state, cache listening, user interactions, and persistence for a Flutter app.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads content details, updates state, and fetches data from repository and database.

methods.name: toggleWatchlist
methods.description: Adds or removes the current content ID from the watchlist stored in cache.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Triggers reloading of content data from cache.

methods.name: playPressed
methods.description: Simulates pressing the play button; updates playback progress.

methods.name: updateProgressSeconds
methods.description: Updates playback progress and persists it.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Legacy method for updating playback progress.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks playback as completed and resets progress.

methods.name: markDownloadEnqueuedLocally
methods.description: Updates download status locally after enqueueing a download.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up listeners and marks the controller as disposed.
